capabilities: Search notes by full vault path and select several at once
Create a shared native color group for the selected notes
List colored notes under their first matching color group
Edit exact-path groups and remove single notes from a rule
Color nodes in the currently focused local graph
extras: Interface is Simplified Chinese only. Uses Obsidian's internal graph APIs, so it may need adaptation after Obsidian updates. Runs locally with no account or network access; global color groups stay in the vault's native graph settings after the plugin is disabled.
intentEvidence: manage existing color groups in Obsidian’s global graph
problem: Coloring a specific set of notes in the graph means writing color-group queries by hand instead of just picking the notes.
summary: Picker that assigns one shared color to several notes by creating a native graph color group.
